parsed_output.overall_summary: This video is a detailed cooking tutorial for 'ram-don' (Jjapaguri), the famous noodle dish from the movie 'Parasite'. The creator begins by shopping for high-quality ingredients, including ribeye steak and fresh mushrooms from M&S Food and specific Korean noodles from Oseyo. The process involves searing the steak in butter, sautéing mushrooms, and combining Nongshim Chapagetti and Neoguri noodles with wilted spinach. The final result is a gourmet version of the cinematic comfort food, garnished with fresh spring onions.

takeaways.statement: Ram-don is made by combining Chapagetti and Neoguri instant noodles.
Using high-quality ribeye steak and a variety of fresh mushrooms elevates the dish from basic instant noodles to a gourmet meal.
Basting the steak in butter adds significant flavor to the meat and the subsequent sautéed mushrooms.

items.name: Noodle Base
items.details: 1 pack Nongshim Chapagetti, 1 pack Nongshim Neoguri

items.name: Protein
items.details: 2 Ribeye steaks seasoned with Maldon sea salt

items.name: Vegetables
items.details: Young spinach, Shiitake mushrooms, Oyster mushrooms, Chestnut mushrooms, Spring onions

items.name: Instructions
items.details: Wilt spinach in a wok. Boil noodles with vegetable flakes. Sear steak in a pan with butter and salt. Sauté mushrooms in steak fat. Combine noodles, spinach, mushrooms, and seasoning packets with a splash of noodle water. Top with sliced steak and spring onions.
